text:
Posting on behalf of friends at Jumping Rivers (<https://www.jumpingrivers.com|jumpingrivers.com>):

Jumping Rivers is a UK consultancy that celebrated its 10th birthday this year. We specialise in R & Python, and are Posit & Databricks partners. Since day 1, we have been remote-first, with our head office in Newcastle upon Tyne. Although remote, we think it's important that we meet occasionally, so we also ensure that we have a get-together a few times a year. One of which is around our conference: <https://aip.jmpr.io/|aip.jmpr.io>

We have a few open roles: data scientist and engineering. If you are interested, please submit an application (<https://jumping-rivers.welcomekit.co/|jumping-rivers.welcomekit.co>). Also happy to have an informal chat (<mailto:colin@jumpingrivers.com|colin@jumpingrivers.com>).

attachments.text: Jumping Rivers is an analytics company whose passion is data and machine learning. We help our clients move from data storage to data insights. Based in Newcastle and founded in 2016, the company is bringing a fresh approach to the world of data analytics. Our trainers and consultants come with over 100 years combined experience in R, Python, Stan, Scala and other programming languages, and our team of data engineers can help you get the most out of your Posit installations through support and managed services.
